About

A sailor, a teacher, and a seeker of clean lines.

I spend a lot of my time on the water, teaching and practicing windsurfing and wingfoiling. I enjoy helping people feel confident, understanding how the wind works, and moving with it rather than against it.

The same mindset applies off the water: I like structure, clarity, and learning by doing. Whether I’m coaching a beginner or refining a technique, I care about building calm confidence and reading the environment well.

What I’m about

  • Reading the wind and the water
  • Teaching with calm confidence
  • Helping people progress safely and enjoyably
  • Chasing the best conditions and the best line
